g.text: Researcher exchanges the UCAN for a bearer JWT
(self-verifying, capped to granter's own clearance -- ADR-036/ADR-043)
Successful read, within scope and before expiration
[researcher attempts to read a specimen OUTSIDE the granted entityScope]
403 (claim does not apply to this EntityId)
(Action: "query", denied -- ADR-045 logs attempted reads too)
[grant has since expired or been revoked]
or after an accessGrantRevoked event for this grant)
check UCAN exp / revocation status at exchange time
(not just relying on a previously issued JWT's own exp)
revocation depends on the IdP actually checking revocation
status at each exchange, same operational requirement ADR-040's
